# Create Venmo private transactions of $200 to each coworker with the provided note
note_text = "I greatly appreaciate your hard work in the sprint!"
amount = 200

venmo_transaction_results=[]
for c in all_coworkers:
    receiver_email = c.get('email')
    print('sending to',receiver_email)
    res = apis.venmo.create_transaction(
        receiver_email=receiver_email,
        amount=amount,
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        description=note_text,
        private=True
    )
    venmo_transaction_results.append({
        'receiver_email': receiver_email,
        'transaction_id': res.get('transaction_id'),
        'message': res.get('message')
    })

print('venmo_transaction_results_count',len(venmo_transaction_results))
print(venmo_transaction_results)

# Login to gmail and send email to all coworkers
# Prepare coworker recipient emails
coworker_emails=[c.get('email') for c in all_coworkers]
print('coworker_emails_count',len(coworker_emails))
print('coworker_emails',coworker_emails)

gmail_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
gmail_username='cheweber@gmail.com'
gmail_login=apis.gmail.login(username=gmail_username, password=gmail_pw)
print('gmail_login',gmail_login)
gmail_access_token=gmail_login.get('access_token')

subject='End of Sprint!'
body="As a token of appreciation for the hard work you put in our sprint, I've sent you a small gift on venmo."

email_send_res=apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=coworker_emails,
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_access_token
)
print('email_send_res',email_send_res)

# Verification pass (single pass): verify Venmo transactions and Gmail email

# Ensure tokens exist
if 'venmo_access_token' not in globals() or not venmo_access_token:
    venmo_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
    venmo_username='cheweber@gmail.com'
    venmo_access_token=apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_username, password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

if 'gmail_access_token' not in globals() or not gmail_access_token:
    gmail_pw=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
    gmail_access_token=apis.gmail.login(username='cheweber@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)['access_token']

note_text = "I greatly appreaciate your hard work in the sprint!"
expected_amount = 200

# Transaction IDs we created
venmo_transaction_ids = [t['transaction_id'] for t in venmo_transaction_results]
print('venmo_transaction_ids',venmo_transaction_ids)

verified_transactions=[]
for tid in venmo_transaction_ids:
    tr=apis.venmo.show_transaction(transaction_id=tid, access_token=venmo_access_token)
    verified_transactions.append({
        'transaction_id': tid,
        'amount': tr.get('amount'),
        'private': tr.get('private'),
        'description': tr.get('description'),
        'receiver_email': (tr.get('receiver') or {}).get('email'),
        'sender_email': (tr.get('sender') or {}).get('email')
    })

print('verified_transactions_count',len(verified_transactions))
print('verified_transactions',verified_transactions)

# Verify Gmail email
expected_coworker_emails=set([c.get('email') for c in all_coworkers])

sent_email_id = email_send_res.get('sent_email_id') if 'email_send_res' in globals() else None
sent_email_thread_id = email_send_res.get('sent_email_thread_id') if 'email_send_res' in globals() else None
print('sent_email_id',sent_email_id,'thread_id',sent_email_thread_id)

email_detail = apis.gmail.show_email(email_id=sent_email_id, access_token=gmail_access_token)
recipients=[r.get('email') for r in (email_detail.get('recipients') or [])]
print('email_detail_subject',email_detail.get('subject'))
print('email_detail_body',email_detail.get('body'))
print('email_detail_recipients',recipients)
print('email_detail_recipients_count',len(recipients))
print('missing',sorted(list(expected_coworker_emails - set(recipients))))
print('extra',sorted(list(set(recipients) - expected_coworker_emails)))

# Success criteria checks
criteria_ok = True
criteria_ok &= (len(verified_transactions) == len(expected_coworker_emails))
# Each transaction must match receiver and amount and privacy and description
for tr in verified_transactions:
    if tr['amount'] != expected_amount:
        criteria_ok=False
        print('amount mismatch',tr)
    if tr['private'] is not True:
        criteria_ok=False
        print('privacy mismatch',tr)
    if tr['description'] != note_text:
        criteria_ok=False
        print('description mismatch',tr)
    if tr['receiver_email'] not in expected_coworker_emails:
        criteria_ok=False
        print('receiver mismatch',tr)

# Email criteria
criteria_ok &= (email_detail.get('subject')=='End of Sprint!')
criteria_ok &= (email_detail.get('body')=="As a token of appreciation for the hard work you put in our sprint, I've sent you a small gift on venmo.")
criteria_ok &= (set(recipients)==expected_coworker_emails)

print('criteria_ok',criteria_ok)
